title: Reading Like a Historian II: Corroboration
goal: Learn the historian's third move — corroboration: reading further independent accounts of the same event, applying the SAME sourcing template to each one (not just the first document you meet), and seeing where accounts agree, disagree, and where the disagreement itself is the most important finding.
time: 45 min · **Materials:** notebook, Session 2 notes (the engraving and Preston's account).
